syllabus.title: AITS:2 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• AITS-1 + Newton's Laws of Motion, Work, Energy & Power, Centre of Mass & System of Particles,Rotational motion.

📌 CHEMISTRY
• AITS-1 + Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure, Thermodynamics & Thermochemistry,Redox Reaction.

📌 BOTANY
• AITS-1 + Cell Cycle and Cell Division, The Living World, Biological Classification, Plant Kingdom.

📌 ZOOLOGY
• AITS-1 + Breathing and Exchange of Gases, Body Fluids and Circulation, Excretory Products & their Elimination.
